prompt: What is the incoming operator going to do before checking the tray?
promptZh: 接班人員在檢查托盤前打算先做什麼？

options.text: Extend the loan with the press team.
options.whyZh: 量規下班前必須歸還，接班人員沒有要求續借。

options.text: Take the borrowed gauge back personally.
options.whyZh: 接班人員會把量規留下，讓交班人員歸還。

options.text: Get their own team’s gauge from the tool desk.
options.zh: 到工具櫃檯領自己組的量規。
options.whyZh: 接班人員不能沿用借來的量規，會帶工單卡到工具櫃檯領自己組的。

options.text: Bring both trays to the press team.
options.zh: 把兩個托盤都拿去沖床組。
options.whyZh: 談話只說到檢查剩餘托盤，沒有要求把托盤交給沖床組。

explanationZh: 接班人員不能沿用借來的量規，會帶工單卡到工具櫃檯領自己組的。
evidence: I can check that tray when my shift starts. Is the gauge at the bench mine to use? / No, they need it back before we leave. Our own gauge is at the tool desk. You can collect it, but bring the job card so they issue the right size. / Got it. I’ll leave the borrowed one here for you to return, then take the card to the desk.
